Class ClientRMIConnection

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.network.rmi.ClientRMIConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientConnection, PersistentClientConnection, VirtualServerRMI, VirtualServer, Remote
public class ClientRMIConnection extends Object implements PersistentClientConnection, VirtualServerRMI
Server-side "brain" representing a single connected client over RMI. Unlike the socket version it has no handler or listener: remote is the client's stub, so calling it dispatches the message across the network directly, and incoming commands arrive as direct remote invocations of this object's methods. Incoming commands are forwarded to the CommandReceiver. It is the RMI counterpart of SocketClientConnection.
